name: Tarifa (Spain)
description: Three horizontal stripes of red, white and blue in the proportions 4:1:1, the red charged with three yellow keys in pale.
history: The flag of Tarifa takes the colours and principal elements of the arms of the city; it was designed in 1992 and, after approval by the municipal council that year, its inclusion in the register of symbols of local entities of Andalusia took place in 2004. It is a rectangular flag of 2:3 of three horizontal stripes, the upper red charged with three vertical yellow keys, the middle white and the lower blue.
